svg.title: link ranges
svg.desc: Recorded mixed-scene verified-link distributions shown as minimum-to-maximum lines, 10th-to-90th-percentile thick lines and median markers. Within-scene n889 ranges 15 to 3376 with median 308; false cross-scene n150 ranges 15 to 85 with median 22. These are summaries, not intervals of statistical uncertainty or evidence for a universal cutoff.
